results.description:
Join me for an immersive Amman walking tour through the vibrant old and new markets of Downtown Amman. We’ll explore lively spots like Al-Bukhari Market, the Fruit and Vegetable Market, and the Tailor’s Market, offering you a true Downtown Amman walking tour experience.

You’ll experience the authentic rhythm of daily Jordanian life, while savoring traditional Arabic flavors during this unique food tour Amman. Enjoy tastings of baklava, kunafa, and local nuts as I share stories behind these beloved treats.

This Amman culture walking tour also reveals local customs, traditions, and deep insights into the real history of the Middle East. Highlights include visits to the Gold Market, the historic Path of the Nymphs, and even a lesson on how to cross Amman’s streets like a local!

Whether you’re passionate about street life, sweets, or social stories, this Amman historical market tour is your perfect gateway to the city’s hidden charm. This Amman city tour goes beyond the guidebooks and connects you with the true soul of the capital.

Note: Minimum 2 participants required. Price excludes food, drinks, tickets, and transportation.

results.whatToExpect:
Ibrahim will lead you for an enriching Amman walking tour where you’ll explore the best of Downtown Amman walking tour spots. He’ll guide you through the most vibrant markets, including Al-Bukhari Market, the Fruit and Vegetable Market, and the Tailor’s Market, each offering a taste of daily Jordanian life.

As part of this cultural experience, you’ll enjoy a food tour Amman style with tastings of baklava, kunafa, and a variety of traditional nuts. Ibrahim will share the history and stories behind each treat, connecting them to broader Arabic culture.

During this Amman culture walking tour, you’ll also gain a deeper understanding of Arabic traditions and the authentic history of the Middle East, beyond what’s in the textbooks. This experience doubles as an Amman historical market tour, perfect for those seeking cultural immersion.

Whether you're a curious traveler or a foodie, this Amman city tour offers the chance to experience Amman through the eyes of a local guide.

results.description: We in the Middle East love to say that we are the cradle of the civilization, but let’s face it, our streets are really packed with historical monuments combining different cultural heritages. The churches in Amman are a proof and they are definitely hidden gems that do not get enough attention. Yet they should and I would like to take you on a tour to show you those temples and tell you their stories. Please note: Price does not include food, drinks, tickets or transportation.

results.description: You will never get hungry in Egypt. Why? Because you will find vendors, food carts, and more. They offer everything you can imagine. You want to taste all and discover what street food in Egypt is all about. We don’t blame you. The air is loaded with irresistible aroma and you want to partake in what locals eat every day. But what if you’re going out to explore only delicious street food to avoid any digestive problems and find out historical food trucks and worthy local small vendor, you need to be accompanied with a local. Please note: Price does not include food, drinks, tickets or transportation.

results.description: You’re in Egypt but haven’t tasted the most popular drink in Egypt? How is that possible. You need to head to one of the local fruit shops to drink Aseer Asab (Sugarcane Juice)! The drink is prepared in front of your eyes, using one of the most traditional machine in Egypt, the Presser (Assara in Arabic). Your drink will be served in a class cup. So, you have to finish your cup in a few seconds and don’t ask why there is no other option. It’s a way to visit Egypt through the eyes of locals. Our guide will get you access to one of the oldest shops in Egypt. Please note: Price does not include food, tickets or transportation.
tourFeatures: Know the best and nearby local fruit shop
Suggest other Egyptian drinks (such as fakfakina)
Being able to explain the the history of asser asab in Egypt
Make sure to keep travellers entertained and avoid any harassment

results.description: You do know that there is no better Shisha than in the Middle East. And the perk of course is that you can choose any flavor you want! Add to that an authentic cup of tea and you are in for a treat. But make no mistake, it’s the locals who know exactly where to go, they go to that specific place that gives every single detail its authentic touch for a truly marvelous experience! And the locals love their Shisha! Want to join on a beautiful evening? Please note: Price does not include food, drinks, tickets or transportation.
